<thought>To find a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to an SN2 substitution, I will search the template catalog for reactions where a halide (e.g., Cl) is broken and a C‑N bond is formed. This matches the forward SN2 description (break halide, form C‑N). I’ll use the search tool with functional_groups_broken set to ["halide"] and functional_groups_formed set to ["amine"] (representing the new C‑N bond). The limit can be small to reduce cost.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
